summary.text: Lisbeth Arescurenaga is the Democratic candidate for Arizona House of Representatives District 24 in the November 3, 2026 general election, having advanced from the July 21, 2026 Democratic primary.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a mental health counselor and community advocate who was born in Lima, Peru, and named education, affordable housing and mental health as priorities.

paragraphs.text: Arescurenaga earned an associate degree from Mesa Community College in 2014, a bachelor's degree from Arizona State University in 2016 and a degree from Ottawa University in 2024, and her Ballotpedia profile lists her profession as counselor.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she immigrated to the United States at age 15, worked full-time while pursuing higher education, and has been involved in community service, advocacy and outreach across Arizona for more than 15 years.
She said she currently works as a Licensed Associate Counselor.
